description:
WHEN: Use when your user asks about THEIR Dantes Desk, watchlist or locked setups — "what is on my desk", "which of my desk names are Strong Buy", "what did my setups land tonight", "what am I watching". Returns the seat your token is bound to; pass include_archive:true for cards no longer live.

NOT for: Not a market screen and not another person’s desk — a token sees only its own seat; without a bound seat it answers no_seat, and then you say so rather than guessing. A card is a dated scan result, never a recommendation; do not present a Desk card as advice to buy.

Returns: { ok, desk: { name, cards_live, cards_archived, cards[] ({ symbol, company_name, setup, as_of, live, dantes_grade, grade_as_of, fields[], levels[], note, landed_by, report_page }) , archive? }, watchlist[], setups[] ({ kind, name, armed, grade_filter }) } or { ok: false, reason: no_seat | no_desk }.
name: get_desk
title: Read the Dantes Desk, watchlist and setups of the seat this token is bound to
